text: 新华社发文称，宏观政策是护航经济稳定运行的重要手段，是推动高质量发展的坚实保障。近日召开的中共中央政治局会议在部署下半年经济工作时，明确提出“宏观政策要发力提效”“实施好更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策”“加大逆周期调节力度”，这些部署着眼当下又利长远，释放出清晰、有力的政策信号。
text_en: Xinhua News Agency reported that macroeconomic policy is an important means to safeguard stable economic operation and a solid guarantee for promoting high-quality development. The recent Political Bureau meeting of the CPC Central Committee, when deploying H2 economic work, clearly stated that 'macro policies should exert force and enhance efficiency,' 'implement more proactive fiscal policies and a moderately loose monetary policy,' and 'strengthen counter-cyclical adjustments.' These deployments address current needs while benefiting the long term, releasing clear and powerful policy signals.
